title: Mehmonxona va sayohatda
goal_uz: Dars oxirida mehmonxonada xona band qilasiz, joylashasiz va xonadan chiqasiz, could va would bilan muloyim iltimos qilasiz, xonadagi muammoni muloyim shikoyat qilasiz va sayohatdagi qiyinchiliklarni inglizcha tushuntirasiz.

vocab.uz: bir / ikki kishilik / ikki karavotli xona

scenes.title: Mehmonxona va sayohatda
board: Lesson 8: At the hotel and on the road
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda shifokorda va dorixonada gaplashishni o‘rgandik: I have a headache, you should rest. Bugun sayohat uchun juda kerakli mavzu: mehmonxona. Xona band qilish, kelish va ketish, iltimos qilish, muammoni muloyim shikoyat qilish va yo‘lda uchraydigan qiyinchiliklar. Dars oxirida mehmonxonada hamma narsani o‘zingiz hal qila olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we learn how to book a room, check in, make polite requests and solve problems when you travel.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun xona band qilishni, joylashishni, muloyim iltimos qilishni va sayohatdagi muammolarni hal qilishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Xona turlari va asosiy so‘zlar

examples.t: I'd like a twin room.
The room has its own bathroom.

scenes.say_native: Avval asosiy so‘zlar. Single room — bir kishilik xona. Double room — ikki kishilik, bitta katta karavot bilan. Twin room — ikkita alohida karavotli xona, do‘stlar uchun qulay. Reservation yoki booking — oldindan band qilish. Reception — qabulxona, key card — xona kaliti. En-suite degani, xonaning ichida hammomi bor. Mehmonxonaga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishdan oldin shu so‘zlarni bilish juda foydali.
scenes.say: A single room. A double room. A twin room. A reservation. Reception. A key card.
scenes.say_uz: Bir kishilik xona. Ikki kishilik xona. Ikki karavotli xona. Band qilish. Qabulxona. Xona kaliti.

scenes.title: Xona band qilish iboralari
board: I'd like to book a double room for two nights.
from the fifth to the seventh of May
How much is it per night?

examples.t: I would like to book a room for three nights.
Do you have any rooms available?

scenes.say_native: Band qilishning asosiy qolipi: I’d like to book, keyin xona turi va muddat. For two nights, ya’ni ikki kechaga. Sana uchun from, to: from the fifth to the seventh of May. Narxni so‘rash: how much is it per night? Is breakfast included? Nonushta narxga kiradimi? Muhim: kunlar emas, kechalar sanaladi, nights. Chunki mehmonxona kecha uchun pul oladi.
scenes.say: I'd like to book a double room for two nights. How much is it per night? Is breakfast included?
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kechaga ikki kishilik xona band qilmoqchiman. Bir kechasi qancha? Nonushta kiradimi?

scenes.title: Dialog: telefonda band qilish
board: G: I'd like to book a double room.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Mehmon mehmonxonaga qo‘ng‘iroq qilib, xona band qiladi. Uchta narsaga e’tibor bering: qanday xona va necha kecha, narxi qancha, nonushta kiradimi. Keyin savollarga javob berasiz. Mehmonning iltimosi muloyim bo‘lganiga ham e’tibor bering, bu iboralarni siz ham ishlatasiz. Qaytadan tinglash shart emas, bir marta diqqat bilan eshiting.
scenes.say: Receptionist: Good morning, Riverside Hotel. Guest: Good morning. I'd like to book a double room for two nights, please. Receptionist: Certainly. We have a double room for eighty pounds a night. Guest: Is breakfast included? Receptionist: Yes, it is. Could I have your name, please? Guest: Karimov, K-A-R-I-M-O-V.
scenes.say_uz: Qabulxona: Xayrli tong, Riverside mehmonxonasi. Mehmon: Xayrli tong. Ikki kechaga ikki kishilik xona band qilmoqchiman. Qabulxona: Albatta. Ikki kishilik xona kechasiga sakson funt. Mehmon: Nonushta kiradimi? Qabulxona: Ha. Ismingizni aytsangiz. Mehmon: Karimov, K-A-R-I-M-O-V.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: qanday xona va necha kechaga? Ikkinchi: bir kechasi qancha? Uchinchi: nonushta narxga kiradimi? To‘liq gap bilan ayting, masalan: he books a double room. Agar javobni topolmasangiz, dialogni yana eslang. Keyingi qismda to‘g‘ri javoblar bor, ularni o‘zingiznikiga solishtirasiz.
scenes.say: What room, and how many nights? How much is it per night? Is breakfast included?
scenes.say_uz: Qanday xona va necha kecha? Bir kechasi qancha? Nonushta kiradimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: band qilish
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Ikki kishilik xona, ikki kechaga. Narxi bir kechasiga sakson funt. Nonushta narxga kiradi, yes, it is. Yana bir e’tibor: mehmon ismini harflab aytdi, K-A-R-I-M-O-V. Familiyani harflab aytish juda foydali, birinchi darsda alifboni shuning uchun o‘rgangan edik.
scenes.say: A double room for two nights. Eighty pounds a night. Yes, breakfast is included.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kechaga ikki kishilik xona. Kechasi sakson funt. Ha, nonushta kiradi.

scenes.title: Band qilishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ I want a room for two days.
✓ I'd like to book a room for two nights.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xatoga e’tibor bering. Birinchi: I want deb to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytish va days ishlatish. I want qo‘pol eshitiladi, I’d like esa muloyim. Mehmonxonada muddatni nights bilan aytamiz. Ikkinchi: include fe’lini o‘zgartirmaslik. Nonushta narxga qo‘shilgan, ya’ni passiv: breakfast is included. Va breakfast oldidan odatda the kerak emas.
scenes.say: I'd like to book a room for two nights. Is breakfast included?
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kechaga xona band qilmoqchiman. Nonushta kiradimi?

scenes.title: Band qilish gapini tuzing
board: Room: double. Nights: 3. Dates: 10 to 13 June.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Siz mehmonxonaga qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapsiz. Uch kechaga ikki kishilik xona kerak, o‘ninchi iyundan o‘n uchinchi iyungacha. Birinchi gap: xona band qilmoqchiman. Keyin narxini va nonushta kiradimi, deb so‘rang. Hammasini ingliz tilida ayting. Gaplaringiz to‘liq va ravon bo‘lishi uchun shoshilmang. Kerak bo‘lsa, avval o‘zingizga ayting.
scenes.say: You are calling a hotel. Book a double room for three nights, from the tenth to the thirteenth of June. Ask the price and about breakfast.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxonaga qo‘ng‘iroq qilyapsiz. Uch kechaga ikki kishilik xona band qiling. Narxini va nonushtani so‘rang.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
From the tenth to the thirteenth of June.
How much is it per night? Is breakfast included?
scenes.say_native: Namuna. I’d like to book a double room for three nights, from the tenth to the thirteenth of June. How much is it per night? Is breakfast included? Sana aytganda inglizchada tartib son bilan the ishlatiladi: the tenth, the thirteenth. Yozuvda 10 June yoki 10th June deb yoziladi, Britaniyada kun oyning oldidan keladi.
scenes.say: I'd like to book a double room for three nights, from the tenth to the thirteenth of June.
scenes.say_uz: Uch kechaga ikki kishilik xona band qilmoqchiman, o‘ninchi iyundan o‘n uchinchi iyungacha.

scenes.title: Mehmonxonaga joylashish
board: I have a reservation under the name Karimov.
Your room is on the second floor.

examples.t: I have a reservation for tonight.
Breakfast is from seven to ten.

scenes.say_native: Mehmonxonaga kelganda: I have a reservation under the name Karimov. Ya’ni Karimov nomiga bronim bor. Qabulxona xodimi passportingizni so‘raydi: can I see your passport? So‘ng kalit beradi va xona qavatini aytadi. Britaniya ingliz tilida ground floor — birinchi qavat, first floor esa uning tepasi, ya’ni bizning ikkinchi qavat. Amerikada first floor — yer qavati. Check-out is at eleven, ya’ni xonani soat o‘n birgacha bo‘shatish kerak.
scenes.say: I have a reservation under the name Karimov. Can I see your passport? Check-out is at eleven.
scenes.say_uz: Karimov nomiga bronim bor. Passportingizni ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Xonadan chiqish vaqti soat o‘n bir.

scenes.title: Joylashish: qisqa suhbat
board: Receptionist: Your room is 204, on the second floor.

examples.t: What time is breakfast?
Is there a lift?

scenes.say_native: Mana joylashish paytidagi suhbat iboralari. Nonushta soat nechada? What time is breakfast? Lift bormi? Is there a lift? Wi-Fi paroli nima? What’s the Wi-Fi password? Lift Britaniyada lift, Amerikada elevator deyiladi. Bunday savollar bilan birinchi kuniyoq kerakli ma’lumotni olasiz.
scenes.say: What time is breakfast? Is there a lift? What's the Wi-Fi password? Your room is two oh four.
scenes.say_uz: Nonushta soat nechada? Lift bormi? Wi-Fi paroli nima? Xonangiz ikki yuz to‘rtinchi.

scenes.title: Qabulxona savollariga javob
board: 3) Would you like a wake-up call?
scenes.say_native: Siz mehmonsiz. Men qabulxona xodimiman. Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: bronlaganmisiz? Ikkinchi: passportingizni ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Uchinchi: ertalab uyg‘otish xizmatini xohlaysizmi? Masalan, yes, I have a reservation under the name Karimov. Javobingiz qisqa bo‘lsa ham yetarli, lekin to‘g‘ri va aniq bo‘lsin.
scenes.say: Have you got a reservation? Can I see your passport? Would you like a wake-up call?
scenes.say_uz: Bron qilganmisiz? Passportingizni ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Uyg‘otish qo‘ng‘irog‘ini xohlaysizmi?

scenes.title: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar
board: Yes, of course. Here you are.
scenes.say_native: Mumkin bo‘lgan javoblar. Yes, under the name Karimov. Yes, of course, here you are. Yes, please, at seven o’clock. Here you are, mana oling, narsa uzatganda aytiladigan odatiy ibora. Bu qisqa javoblar suhbatni tez va ravon qiladi. Ularni bir butun ibora sifatida yodlab oling.
scenes.say: Yes, under the name Karimov. Yes, of course. Here you are. Yes, please. At seven.
scenes.say_uz: Ha, Karimov nomiga. Ha, albatta. Marhamat. Ha, iltimos. Soat yettida.

scenes.title: Xonadan chiqish
board: I'd like to check out, please.
Can I have the bill, please?

examples.t: Could we leave our bags here until four?
examples.uz: Sumkalarimizni to‘rtgacha shu yerda qoldirsak bo‘ladimi?

scenes.say_native: Ketayotganda aytiladigan iboralar. I’d like to check out, xonani topshirmoqchiman. Can I have the bill, please? Hisobni bersangiz. Britaniyada bill, Amerikada check ham deyiladi. Can I pay by card? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Could you call a taxi? Taksi chaqirib bera olasizmi? Reysgacha vaqt bo‘lsa, could we leave our bags here? deb so‘rang.
scenes.say: I'd like to check out, please. Can I have the bill? Can I pay by card? Could you call a taxi?
scenes.say_uz: Xonani topshirmoqchiman. Hisobni bersangiz. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Taksi chaqirib bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Muloyim iltimos shakllari
board: Can I ...? / Could I ...? (men qilsam bo‘ladimi)
Can you ...? / Could you ...? (siz qila olasizmi)

examples.t: Could I have a towel, please?
Would you open the window, please?

scenes.say_native: Iltimosni ingliz tilida muloyim aytish juda muhim. Ikki turi bor. Birinchi: o‘zim nimadir olmoqchiman yoki qilmoqchiman. Can I yoki could I, keyin fe’l: could I have a towel, please? Ikkinchi: siz mendan nimadir qilishingizni so‘rayman. Can you, could you, would you: would you open the window, please? Could va would can dan muloyimroq. I’d like esa menga kerak degan muloyim shakl.
scenes.say: Could I have a towel, please? Could you help me, please? Would you open the window? I'd like a quiet room.
scenes.say_uz: Sochiq bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Derazani ochib bera olasizmi? Menga tinch xona kerak.

scenes.title: Iltimoslar ketma-ketligi
board: Could I have the key, please? ✓✓

examples.t: Can I have another pillow?
Could you send some towels to my room?

scenes.say_native: Muloyimlik darajalari. Give me the key — buyruq, qo‘pol. Can I have the key? — oddiy va muloyim. Could I have the key, please? — eng muloyim. Mehmonxona xodimlari bilan can ham, could ham yaxshi, lekin notanish kishi bilan yoki muhim iltimosda could yaxshiroq. Oxirida please qo‘shing va yumshoq ohangda ayting.
scenes.say: Can I have another pillow? Could you send some towels to my room, please?
scenes.say_uz: Yana bitta yostiq bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Xonamga sochiq yuborsangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtiring

examples.t: Could you help me, please?

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida iltimosni siz va iltimos so‘zi, bering qo‘shimchasi bilan muloyim qilamiz: kalitni bering, iltimos. Inglizchada fe’l shakli yetarli emas, muloyimlik can, could, would orqali yaratiladi. Shuning uchun give me the key deyilsa, ingliz qulog‘iga buyruq kabi eshitiladi, o‘zbekcha tarjima qilib aytsangiz, qo‘pol bo‘lib chiqishi mumkin. Rus tilidagi dayte so‘zi ham xuddi shunday.
scenes.say: In Uzbek you say please. In English you need could or can too.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbekchada iltimos deysiz. Inglizchada could yoki can ham kerak.

scenes.title: Iltimosdagi xatolar
board: ✓ Could you help me? / I'd like a taxi.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni eslab qoling. Birinchi: give me deb buyruq ohangida aytish. Ikkinchi: can you dan keyin to qo‘yish, can you to help. Can, could, would dan keyin to kelmaydi, fe’lning oddiy shakli. Uchinchi: I want a taxi deb talab qilish. I’d like a taxi yoki could you call a taxi, please? deng. Muloyimlik ingliz tilida ham xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi bilan munosabatning yarmi.
scenes.say: Could you help me? Not can you to help. I'd like a taxi, please.
scenes.say_uz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Can you to help emas. Taksi kerak edi, iltimos.

scenes.title: Muloyim qiling
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta qo‘pol gapni muloyim qiling. Birinchi: give me a towel. Ikkinchi: I want another key. Uchinchi: call a taxi. Har biri uchun could yoki would yoki I’d like ishlating va oxirida please qo‘shing. Birinchi gapingiz tayyor bo‘lgach, qolgan ikkitasini ham shunday qiling. Har safar please ni oxirida eslang.
scenes.say: Make these polite. Give me a towel. I want another key. Call a taxi.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim qiling. Menga sochiq bering. Menga yana kalit kerak. Taksi chaqiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar: muloyim iltimos
board: 1) Could I have a towel, please?
2) Could I have another key, please?
3) Could you call a taxi, please?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Could I have a towel, please? Could I have another key, please? Could you call a taxi, please? Boshqa to‘g‘ri variantlar ham bor: can I have, would you call. Muhimi, give me va I want yo‘q. Ko‘rdingizmi, o‘zimiz olmoqchi bo‘lsak could I, boshqadan qilishini so‘rasak could you deymiz.
scenes.say: Could I have a towel, please? Could I have another key? Could you call a taxi, please?
scenes.say_uz: Sochiq bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Yana bitta kalit bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Taksi chaqirib bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Iltimosga javob va rad etish

examples.t: I'm afraid the pool is closed today.
Certainly, just a moment, please.

scenes.say_native: Javob berish ham muhim. Rozilik: of course, certainly, sure, no problem. Certainly eng rasmiysi, sure esa erkinroq. Rad etishda to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri no demaymiz. I’m sorry, but yoki I’m afraid dan boshlaymiz: I’m afraid the pool is closed today. Just a moment, please, bir daqiqa kuting. Mehmonxona xodimlari shu iboralarni juda ko‘p ishlatadi, shuning uchun siz ham ularni tushunishingiz kerak.
scenes.say: Of course. Certainly. No problem. Just a moment, please. I'm afraid the pool is closed.
scenes.say_uz: Albatta. Mayli. Muammo yo‘q. Bir daqiqa kuting. Afsuski, hovuz yopiq.

scenes.title: Xonadagi muammolar
board: The room is dirty / noisy / too cold.

examples.t: The Wi-Fi doesn't work.
There are no clean towels.

scenes.say_native: Endi muammolar. Biror narsa ishlamasa: the air conditioning doesn’t work, the Wi-Fi doesn’t work. Narsa yo‘q bo‘lsa: there is no hot water, there are no clean towels, yoki there aren’t any towels. Xona haqida: the room is dirty, noisy, too cold. Ko‘plik sanaladigan otlar bilan there are, birlik yoki sanalmaydigan otlar bilan there is. Water sanalmaydi, shuning uchun there is no hot water.
scenes.say: The air conditioning doesn't work. There is no hot water. The room is dirty. There are no clean towels.
scenes.say_uz: Konditsioner ishlamayapti. Issiq suv yo‘q. Xona iflos. Toza sochiqlar yo‘q.

scenes.title: Muloyim shikoyat formulasi
board: 1) Excuse me / I'm sorry to bother you, but ...
3) request: Could you send someone / Could I change rooms?

examples.t: I'm sorry to bother you, but the shower doesn't work.
examples.uz: Bezovta qilganim uchun uzr, lekin dush ishlamayapti.

examples.t: Could I change rooms, please?

scenes.say_native: Shikoyat qilishning uch qadami bor. Birinchi: kechirim so‘rash, excuse me yoki I’m sorry to bother you, but. Ikkinchi: muammoni aniq aytish, there’s no hot water. Uchinchi: iltimos qilish, could you send someone? yoki could I change rooms? Bu usul sizni sababsiz asabiylashgan mehmon emas, balki aniq yechim kutayotgan odam qilib ko‘rsatadi va yechimni tezroq topasiz.
scenes.say: I'm sorry to bother you, but there's no hot water. Could you send someone, please?
scenes.say_uz: Bezovta qilganim uchun uzr, lekin issiq suv yo‘q. Birovni yuborsangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Shikoyatdagi xatolar
board: ✓ The shower doesn't work. Could you fix it?
scenes.say_native: Uch xatoga e’tibor bering. Birinchi: umuman, your hotel is bad deb hujum qilish. Muammoni aniq aytish yaxshiroq. Ikkinchi: the shower not working, bu yerda doesn’t yoki isn’t kerak. Uchinchi: doesn’t dan keyin works deyish. Doesn’t dan keyin fe’l asosiy shaklda: doesn’t work. Faqat bitta s bo‘ladi, doesn’t da, works da emas.
scenes.say: The shower doesn't work. Could you fix it, please?
scenes.say_uz: Dush ishlamayapti. Tuzatib bera olasizmi?

scenes.title: Shikoyat qiling
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Qabulxonaga uchta shikoyat qiling, muloyim usulda. Birinchi: issiq suv yo‘q. Ikkinchi: xona shovqinli. Uchinchi: sochiq yo‘q. Har birida uzr, muammo va iltimosni ayting. Masalan: I’m sorry to bother you, but there is no hot water. Could you help me?
scenes.say: Complain politely. No hot water. A noisy room. No towels.
scenes.say_uz: Muloyim shikoyat qiling. Issiq suv yo‘q. Shovqinli xona. Sochiq yo‘q.

scenes.title: Namuna shikoyatlar
board: There is no hot water. Could you send someone?
The room is noisy. Could I change rooms?
There are no towels. Could I have some, please?
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. There is no hot water, could you send someone? The room is noisy, could I change rooms? There are no towels, could I have some, please? Birinchi gapda there is, ikkinchisida the room is, uchinchisida there are, chunki towels ko‘plik. Shu moslikni eslab qoldingizmi?
scenes.say: There is no hot water. The room is noisy. There are no towels. Could I have some, please?
scenes.say_uz: Issiq suv yo‘q. Xona shovqinli. Sochiq yo‘q. Bir nechta bersangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Dialog: shikoyat
board: Guest: I'm sorry to bother you, but there's a problem.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog: mehmon xonasida muammo bor va qabulxonaga keldi. Tinglang: qanday muammolar bor, xona raqami nechta va mehmon nima qarorga keladi. Mehmon qanday muloyim bo‘lganiga e’tibor bering. Bu dialogdagi mehmon g‘azablanmaydi, aniq va muloyim gapiradi, shuning uchun muammosi tezroq hal bo‘ladi. Shu usulni yodda tuting.
scenes.say: Guest: Excuse me. I'm sorry to bother you, but there's a problem with my room. Receptionist: I'm sorry to hear that. What's the problem? Guest: There's no hot water, and the air conditioning doesn't work. Receptionist: I apologise. What's your room number? Guest: It's 305. Receptionist: Would you like to change rooms? Guest: Yes, please. That would be great.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmon: Kechirasiz, bezovta qilganim uchun uzr, xonamda muammo bor. Qabulxona: Eshitib afsusdaman. Qanday muammo? Mehmon: Issiq suv yo‘q va konditsioner ishlamayapti. Qabulxona: Kechirasiz. Xona raqamingiz? Mehmon: 305. Qabulxona: Xonani almashtirmoqchimisiz? Mehmon: Ha, iltimos. Juda yaxshi bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: xonada qanday muammolar bor? Ikkinchi: xona raqami nechta? Uchinchi: mehmon nima qaror qiladi? To‘liq gap bilan ayting. Javoblaringizni tayyorlab oling va keyingi qismdagi javoblar bilan solishtiring. Gaplaringizni to‘liq aytishga harakat qiling, bu nutqingizni yaxshilaydi.
scenes.say: What problems are there? What is the room number? What does the guest decide?
scenes.say_uz: Qanday muammolar bor? Xona raqami nechta? Mehmon nima qaror qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: shikoyat dialogi
board: 1) no hot water; the air conditioning doesn't work
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Issiq suv yo‘q va konditsioner ishlamayapti. Xona raqami uch yuz besh. Mehmon xonani almashtirishga rozi bo‘ladi: yes, please. Diqqat qiling, qabulxona xodimi I apologise deb kechirim so‘radi, bu rasmiy va hurmatli ibora. Amerikada I apologize deb yoziladi.
scenes.say: No hot water and the air conditioning doesn't work. Room 305. He changes rooms.
scenes.say_uz: Issiq suv yo‘q, konditsioner ishlamayapti. 305-xona. U xonani almashtiradi.

scenes.title: Sayohatdagi muammolar

examples.t: My flight is delayed.
I missed the last bus.

scenes.say_native: Yo‘lda uchraydigan qiyinchiliklar. The flight is delayed — reys kechikmoqda. The flight is cancelled — bekor qilindi. Missed — o‘tkazib yubormoq, I missed my train. Lost — yo‘qotmoq, I lost my passport. Bular o‘tgan zamon shakllari: miss — missed muntazam, lose — lost noto‘g‘ri fe’l. Luggage yoki baggage — yuk, suitcase — chamadon. Luggage sanalmaydi: luggage, a luggage emas.
scenes.say: The flight is delayed. I missed my train. I lost my passport. My suitcase didn't arrive.
scenes.say_uz: Reys kechikmoqda. Poyezdga kechikdim. Passportimni yo‘qotdim. Chamadonim yetib kelmadi.

scenes.title: Miss, lose, leave
board: ✗ I forgot my bag in the taxi.
✓ I left my bag in the taxi.

examples.t: I left my phone in the room.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbekcha so‘zlar ingliz tilida bir nechta fe’lga bo‘linadi. Poyezdga yetolmaslik inglizchada miss, lose emas: I missed my train. Biror narsani yo‘qotsangiz, lose: I lost my passport. Narsani biror joyda unutib qoldirsangiz, forget emas, leave: I left my bag in the taxi. Forget esa faqat esdan chiqarishda: I forgot her name. Bu uch fe’lni ajratish juda muhim.
scenes.say: I missed my train. I lost my passport. I left my bag in the taxi.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezdga kechikdim. Passportimni yo‘qotdim. Sumkamni taksida qoldirdim.

scenes.title: Miss, lose yoki leave?
board: 3) I ___ my umbrella on the bus.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapga mos fe’lni o‘tgan zamonda ayting. Birinchi: men reysga kechikdim. Ikkinchi: hamyonimni yo‘qotdim, topa olmayapman. Uchinchi: soyabonni avtobusda qoldirib ketdim. Miss, lose yoki leave tanlang. Har bir gapda to‘g‘ri fe’lni ayting va uni o‘tgan zamon shaklida tuzing. Agar ikkilansangiz, ma’noni o‘ylang.
scenes.say: I ... my flight. I ... my wallet. I ... my umbrella on the bus. Miss, lose or leave?
scenes.say_uz: Reysimni ... Hamyonimni ... Soyabonimni avtobusda ... Miss, lose yoki leave?

scenes.title: Javoblar: miss, lose, leave
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. I missed my flight. I lost my wallet. I left my umbrella on the bus. Leave ning o‘tgan zamoni left, noto‘g‘ri fe’l. Lose ning o‘tgan zamoni lost. Ikkalasini ham noto‘g‘ri fe’llar ro‘yxatingizga qo‘shib yodlang. Missed esa oddiy ed bilan yasaladi.
scenes.say: I missed my flight. I lost my wallet. I left my umbrella on the bus.
scenes.say_uz: Reysimga kechikdim. Hamyonimni yo‘qotdim. Soyabonimni avtobusda qoldirdim.

scenes.title: Yordam so‘rash
board: Excuse me, where is the lost property office?
Could you tell me where the gate is?
Is there a bus to the city centre?

examples.t: When is the next train to London?
Could you tell me where the platform is?

scenes.say_native: Yo‘lda yordam so‘rash iboralari. Excuse me, where is the lost property office? Yo‘qolgan narsalar bo‘limi qayerda, Amerikada lost and found deyiladi. Could you tell me where the gate is? Muhim: could you tell me dan keyin so‘z tartibi oddiy gapdagidek, where the gate is, is oxirida. Bu iborani hozircha tayyor qolip sifatida o‘rganing.
scenes.say: Excuse me, where is the lost property office? Could you tell me where the gate is? When is the next train?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, yo‘qolgan narsalar bo‘limi qayerda? Gate qayerdaligini ayta olasizmi? Keyingi poyezd qachon?

scenes.title: Dialog: yo‘qolgan chamadon
board: Passenger: It's a big blue suitcase.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi dialog aeroportda. Yo‘lovchining chamadoni yetib kelmagan. Tinglang: muammo nima, chamadon qanday va uni qachon yetkazishadi. Bu dialog sizga haqiqiy vaziyatda juda asqotadi. Diqqat bilan eshiting, chunki unda chamadonning rangi va kattaligi, qayerga yetkazilishi aytiladi. Bu uchta ma’lumotni toping.
scenes.say: Passenger: Excuse me. My suitcase didn't arrive. Agent: I'm sorry about that. Could you describe it? Passenger: It's a big blue suitcase. Agent: And where are you staying? Passenger: At the Riverside Hotel. Agent: Don't worry. We will bring it to your hotel tomorrow morning.
scenes.say_uz: Yo‘lovchi: Kechirasiz. Chamadonim yetib kelmadi. Xodim: Afsusdaman. Uni ta’riflab bera olasizmi? Yo‘lovchi: Katta ko‘k chamadon. Xodim: Qayerda turasiz? Yo‘lovchi: Riverside mehmonxonasida. Xodim: Xavotir olmang. Ertaga ertalab mehmonxonangizga olib boramiz.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 2) What does the suitcase look like?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Birinchi: muammo nima? Ikkinchi: chamadon qanday ko‘rinishda? Uchinchi: uni qachon va qayerga olib kelishadi? To‘liq gap bilan ayting. Javoblaringizni tayyorlab oling va keyingi qismdagi javoblar bilan solishtiring. Gaplaringizni to‘liq aytishga harakat qiling, bu nutqingizni yaxshilaydi.
scenes.say: What is the problem? What does the suitcase look like? When will they bring it?
scenes.say_uz: Muammo nima? Chamadon qanday ko‘rinishda? Uni qachon olib kelishadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: aeroport dialogi
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Uning chamadoni yetib kelmagan. Chamadon katta va ko‘k. Uni ertaga ertalab mehmonxonaga olib kelishadi. Esda tuting, buyumni tasvirlashda sifatlar tartibi: avval o‘lcham, keyin rang, big blue suitcase. Bu tartib keyingi darslarda ham kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: His suitcase didn't arrive. It is big and blue. They will bring it tomorrow morning.
scenes.say_uz: Uning chamadoni yetib kelmagan. U katta va ko‘k. Ertaga ertalab olib kelishadi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: could you va so‘z urg‘usi

examples.t: Could you help me?

scenes.say_native: Tez gapirganda could you ikki so‘z emas, bitta so‘zdek eshitiladi: kudja. D va y qo‘shilib dj tovushini beradi. Ayniqsa would you ham shunday, wudja. Can I esa kenay kabi bog‘lanadi. Urg‘u haqida: reservation so‘zida urg‘u veyshn oldidagi bo‘g‘inda, rezeVAYshn. Luggage — lagij, passport — paspot. Muloyim iltimosda ovoz oxirida biroz ko‘tariladi.
scenes.say: Could you help me? Would you open the window? Can I have a key? Reservation. Luggage. Passport.
scenes.say_uz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Derazani ochib bera olasizmi? Kalit bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Bron. Yuk. Passport.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Could you ni bog‘lab ayting, kudja. Oxirida ovozingiz biroz ko‘tarilsin, muloyim eshitilishi uchun. Reservation so‘zini urg‘u bilan ayting, rezeVAYshn. Sekin boshlang, keyin tezroq ayting. Har bir iborani ikki marta takrorlang. Muloyim iltimosda ohang biroz ko‘tarilishini unutmang.
scenes.say: Could you help me? Would you open the window? Can I have a key? Reservation. Luggage. Passport.
scenes.say_uz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Derazani ochasizmi? Kalit bersangiz bo‘ladimi? Bron. Yuk. Passport.

scenes.title: Talaffuz bo‘yicha izoh
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Could you ni bog‘lab ayta olsangiz, nutqingiz tabiiy eshitiladi. Lekin tushunarsiz bo‘lsa, sekinroq va aniq ayting, bu ham mutlaqo to‘g‘ri. Luggage so‘zining urg‘usi birinchi bo‘g‘inda, passport ham shunday. Reservation esa uchinchi bo‘g‘inda urg‘u oladi, ya’ni vey bo‘g‘inida.
scenes.say: Could you help me? Reservation. Luggage. Passport.
scenes.say_uz: Menga yordam bera olasizmi? Bron. Yuk. Passport.

scenes.title: Rol o‘yini: joylashing va muammoni ayting
board: 1) Check in: I have a reservation under the name ...
2) Report a problem: There's no ... / The ... doesn't work.
3) Ask politely: Could I ...? / Could you ...?
scenes.say_native: Asosiy vazifa: rol o‘yini. Siz mehmonxonaga keldingiz. Birinchi: bron qilganingizni ayting va ismingizni bering. Ikkinchi: xonangizdagi bir muammoni ayting. Uchinchi: uni hal qilish uchun muloyim iltimos qiling, could I yoki could you bilan. Kamida uchta jumla ayting.
scenes.say: You arrive at a hotel. Check in, report a problem in your room and ask politely for help.
scenes.say_uz: Mehmonxonaga keldingiz. Joylashing, xonadagi muammoni ayting va muloyim yordam so‘rang.

scenes.title: Namuna rol o‘yini
board: I have a reservation under the name Karimov.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Karimov. Keyin xonada: I’m sorry to bother you, but the shower doesn’t work. Could you send someone, please? Yoki could I change rooms? Sizning variantingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Asosiysi, uzr, aniq muammo va could bilan iltimos bor bo‘lsa, siz bugungi darsning asosiy maqsadiga erishdingiz.
scenes.say: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Karimov. The shower doesn't work. Could you send someone, please?
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kech. Karimov nomiga bronim bor. Dush ishlamayapti. Birovni yuborsangiz bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Qisqacha takrorlash
board: I'd like to book a double room for two nights.
I have a reservation under the name ...
Could I ...? Could you ...? Would you ..., please?
There is no hot water. The shower doesn't work.
scenes.say_native: Darsni yakunlaymiz. Xona band qilish uchun I’d like to book, nights bilan muddatni aytamiz. Kelganda I have a reservation under the name. Iltimos uchun could I va could you, buyruq emas. Shikoyat uchun uzr, muammo va iltimos. Sayohatda miss, lose va leave fe’llarini ajratamiz. Shu iboralar bilan ingliz tilida sayohat qilish ancha oson.
scenes.say: Book with I'd like to. Ask with could. Complain politely. Miss a train, lose a passport, leave a bag.
scenes.say_uz: I'd like to bilan band qiling. Could bilan so‘rang. Muloyim shikoyat qiling. Poyezdga kechikasiz, passport yo‘qotasiz, sumka qoldirasiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Homework: role-play check-in + a room problem
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: mehmonxonaga joylashish va xonadagi muammoni aytish rol o‘yinini yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib o‘ynang. Kamida oltita gap bo‘lsin: bron, passport, muammo va ikkita muloyim iltimos. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: can, could, would dan keyin to yo‘q, muammo gapi esa doesn’t work yoki there is no bilan to‘g‘ri tuzilgan. Keyingi darsda ish va o‘qish hayoti haqida gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: role-play checking in and reporting a problem in your room. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: joylashish va xonadagi muammoni aytish rol o‘yini. Yana ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Mehmonxonaga joylashish va xonadagi muammoni aytish rol o‘yinini yozing yoki ovoz chiqarib o‘ynang. Kamida oltita gap: bron, muammo va ikkita muloyim iltimos. Mezon: can, could, would dan keyin to yo‘q, muammo doesn't work yoki there is no bilan to‘g‘ri aytilgan.

quiz.q: Which is the most polite at reception?
options: Could I have the key, please?
quiz.why_uz: Could I have ... please eng muloyim shakl.
Could dan keyin to yo‘q, fe’lning oddiy shakli.

quiz.q: I'd like to book a room for two ___.
quiz.why_uz: Mehmonxonada muddat kechalar bilan: two nights.
Doesn't dan keyin fe'l o‘zgarmaydi: doesn't work.

quiz.q: There ___ no hot water in my room.
quiz.why_uz: Water sanalmaydi, shuning uchun there is no hot water.

quiz.q: I ___ my train, so I took the next one.
I ___ my bag in the taxi.
quiz.why_uz: Narsani joyda qoldirish: left, leave ning o‘tgan zamoni.
Nonushta narxga qo‘shilgan: passiv, is included.

quiz.q: Check-out is at eleven. What does it mean?
options: You must leave the room by eleven.
Could you tell me where is the gate?
Could you tell me where the gate is?
Could you tell me where the gate?
Could you to tell me where the gate is?
quiz.why_uz: Could you tell me dan keyin oddiy tartib: where the gate is.
